subject: pe
title: Health & Nutrition: Foundations
welcome_lead: Food fuels your body and brain — pick wisely.
meta_desc: KS3 PE: food groups, balanced diet, why each matters.
final_note: Eat the rainbow — your body will thank you.

concepts.def: Main energy fuel — bread, rice, pasta.
For growth and muscle repair — meat, beans.
Small nutrient needed in tiny amounts.
Like iron, calcium — needed for many jobs.

walkthroughs.body_html: Carbohydrates fuel sport. Fats are a long-burn energy. Athletes eat plenty of both around training.
Protein repairs muscle after exercise. Beans, eggs, fish, meat and dairy are all sources.
Vitamins and minerals keep systems working. Fibre from veg and wholegrains keeps digestion healthy.

mcqs.q: Main energy fuel for sport is:

options: The maximum air your lungs can hold.
Air left in the lungs after maximum exhalation.
Volume of air inhaled or exhaled in one normal breath at rest.

mcqs.q: Which type of muscle is under voluntary control?
